t_test.title: Delivery Delay vs Customer Review Score
t_test.conclusion: Delayed orders receive significantly lower review scores compared to on-time orders (p < 0.001).

anova.title: Product Category vs Order Value
anova.conclusion: Average order spending varies significantly across top product categories (p < 0.001).

chi_square.title: Payment Method vs Order Status
chi_square.conclusion: Significant association exists between customer payment methods and order statuses (p < 0.001).
